fields.stage: Recruiting global Phase 3 AURORA programme; completed Phase 2 sponsor results
fields.summary: Oral ASC30 is an investigational once-daily small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist. The sponsor reported the first participant dosed in the global Phase III AURORA programme. AURORA-1 studies adults with obesity or overweight without type 2 diabetes and records 3,003 estimated participants; AURORA-2 studies adults with obesity or overweight and type 2 diabetes and records 1,560 estimated participants. Both sponsor-submitted records are recruiting, have actual August 2026 starts, use 20 mg, 40 mg and 60 mg maintenance-dose groups versus placebo over 72 weeks, and have no posted results. The earlier completed US Phase 2 study and sponsor-reported results remain separate evidence.
fields.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for oral ASC30. Phase III recruitment and planned US or EU submissions are not UK approval.
fields.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed research evidence.
fields.supply: Global Phase III research and a completed US Phase 2 study do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or a product sold by Shift Some Timber.
fields.limitations: The registries estimate 3,003 and 1,560 participants, while the sponsor describes approximately 4,600 across both trials; these figures are not actual enrolment. July 2028 completion, third-quarter 2028 topline data, an end-2028 US NDA and an early-2029 EMA application are estimates or sponsor plans, not completed events. Neither registry has posted results, so Phase III efficacy, safety, durability or superiority is not established. AURORA-2 is specialist type 2 diabetes research and must not be presented as results for people without diabetes. The oral formulation remains separate from depot ASC30 injection. None of this establishes UK authorisation, NICE/NHS access or UK supply.
